title: A Cadet Becomes A Prophet
desc: Fernan Fallenberg, heir to the Empire’s most prestigious household and a prodigy of the Imperial Academy, was infamous for valuing everything by money and keeping others at a distance. One day, he is struck by lightning, and a foreign presence tries to invade his mind. Resisting with force, he instead witnesses the Book of Prophecies reveal itself foretelling the world’s end.

title: Academy'S Genius Swordmaster
desc: Setelah berhasil mengalahkan raksasa Ahayute, Ronan bersiap menyambut kematian dengan tubuhnya yang melemah. Namun di saat-saat terakhirnya, muncul 'delapan sayap' yang menginvasi bumi. Sebelum Ronan sempat bertarung melawan makhluk tersebut, suatu hal terjadi yang membuat ia kembali ke masa remajanya–sekitar 10 tahun sebelum monster dan raksasa mendatangi bumi. Berbekal ingatan dan keahlian pedangnya, Ronan mulai mempersiapkan diri untuk peperangan yang akan terjadi di masa depan.

title: Children Of The Rune
desc: After the destruction of his House by his uncle, all that was left for a young boy, Boris, was the heirloom sword, Winterer. But little did he know that this treasure would become the cause of another crisis. As people seek Winterer, Boris’ heart grows colder and bleaker, much like the winter. The adventures of Boris — to survive and to protect the sword of his House — begin now. What awaits him at the end of this journey? And what secrets does the winter sword Winterer hold?
